description: Convert CSV to JSON with a strict RFC 4180 parser: quoted fields, escaped quotes, embedded newlines, CRLF, BOM. Auto-detects the delimiter (comma, semicolon, tab, pipe) or takes one; uses the first row as keys by default (or returns arrays), and optionally infers numbers, booleans and empty-as-null. Pass CSV text or a URL to fetch (max 2 MB, 10,000 rows returned; truncation is flagged). Deterministic, no AI.

header.description: Treat the first row as column names and return objects (default true); false returns arrays

inferTypes.description: Convert numbers, true/false, and empty cells to null (default true); false keeps every value a string

maxRows.description: Maximum data rows to return, up to 10,000 (default 10,000)

url.description: Public URL of a CSV file to fetch instead

name: csv_to_json
